Query data of a Dataset part.
This endpoint is only available for dataset parts that support queries (type == DB).

request.name:
Query data of a Dataset part.
This endpoint is only available for dataset parts that support queries (type == DB).

description.content: Execute a query against a dataset part. Results are returned as plain-text CSV. Only available for parts with type=DB.
